profile.headline: AI Automation Software Engineer at Nextlink Internet
profile.summary:
Eric Nwokocha is a software engineer and AI systems builder with 6+ years of experience across defense, aviation, logistics, and enterprise software. He's worked on embedded C/C++ on mission-critical systems, infrastructure, and moved up the stack into applied AI, where he currently builds LLM-powered automation and AI integration layers.
 
His work sits at the intersection of application engineering and artificial intelligence. He cares about building things that are reliable, well-architected, and useful, from a TCP/IP communication module on a Xilinx SoC or a generative AI pipeline that reduces manual overhead for a software team.
 
Eric holds an active Top Secret security clearance and a B.S. in Computer Engineering from UNT, where his senior capstone in facial recognition won the department's People's Choice Award. He's currently pursuing graduate studies in Computational Linguistics, with research interests in NLP, speech recognition, and machine translation.
